These probabilities are rough judgments from general knowledge of NAS-Bench-201, not computed from the benchmark data. The main heuristics I used:

- Edits that replace a weak op (none or pooling) with a conv help more when the competing paths are weak.
- Edits that add a conv on edge 1 or edge 4 matter less when edge 3 already provides a strong path.
- Edits that remove an edge hurt more when the remaining paths are weak.
- Most pairs involve conditions with only a modest interaction, so N dominates.
